note: Regexes are case-insensitive and use the JS/Python common subset. A finding matches an entry when its 'file' matches `file` and its whole flat object text matches both `locator` and `keywords`.

defects.summary: lid.window_frame_wall 0.35 mm < SLA minimum wall (0.5 mm supported / 1.0 mm unsupported)
PCB boss at (18, 8) sits inside the 40 x 25 mm cell footprint and collides with the cell
tether soldered straight to PCB pads through a plain hole; no boot/clamp/knot vs 20 N pull requirement
lid_gap worst case is -0.05..0.45 mm (report dropped the gasket tolerance and passed a 0.00 mm min against a 0.05 mm limit)
U3 LDO 5.0->1.8 V at 150 mA dissipates 0.48 W, not 0.048 W; Tj ~141 C > 105 C
exposed charging pogo contacts J2 connect straight to U1 with no TVS/ESD clamp vs 8 kV requirement
REQ-ELEC-002 (8 kV ESD, Verify: test) has no test in trace.json or the test plan
marketing claims medical-grade accuracy and AFib detection with no evidence (and a regulated medical claim)

acceptable.summary: REQ-MECH-003 gap limits vs worst-case output also fail the upper limit
U3 fed from VBUS instead of VBAT while charging (root cause of the dissipation)
exposed VBUS contacts drive U1/Q1 with no overvoltage protection vs abs max
EV-0003 provenance (git sha not in history)
true process-completeness finding on project artefacts (ASSUMPTIONS, RISKS, systems model, gate records, forge.toml gate)
true requirement-quality finding (missing tolerance/condition, undefined term, unverifiable)
pcb.afe_top_height is itself a sum of toleranced parts; the stack should expand it

decoys.summary: U2 buck dissipation 0.066 W is correct
5-day battery claim is backed by EV-0003 (L4)

note_acceptable: acceptable = true findings that were not planted (counted correct for precision, not in recall). A finding is a false positive only if it matches no planted defect and no acceptable entry: i.e. it is wrong, or it flags a decoy (a deliberately correct item).
